notes: - contradiction: "Thalassiodracon is considered one of the oldest plesiosaur representatives and may be ancestral to the superfamily Pliosauroidea, which includes short-necked plesiosaurs." / "Thalassiodracon lived in Europe from the Late Triassic to the Early Jurassic, approximately 201.6 to 196.5 million years ago.": Sentence 12 claims Thalassiodracon is one of the oldest plesiosaur representatives, yet sentence 13 places it in the Late Triassic to Early Jurassic (≈201.6–196.5 Ma), a period that is not the earliest for plesiosaurs.
